evals.name: appends-instead-of-fragmenting
evals.setup: `kb/_inbox.md` holds a confirmed fact that correlation uses a per-material propagation speed. A knowledge-base page on correlation already exists and is long enough to look worth splitting.

evals.name: writes-to-the-inbox-at-confirmation
evals.setup: `srd:create` runs on specs/gateway.md. The interview surfaces a platform fact the corpus does not carry, and the user confirms it in a branch restatement.

evals.name: restructure-repairs-every-reference
evals.setup: A `##` section moves out of `_inbox.md` into a new page. A gap record cites the inbox section's `doc_id`, and an SRD cites it too. A deferred question about that section is open gap `gap-0043`, also citing the inbox; the section carries its `> Open: gap-0043.` warning line.
